## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -8.41%) BELOW TREND showing fear easing, and Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT proxy: 1W: +3.52% | 1M: +6.78%) ABOVE TREND showing equities beating bonds; modest headwind from credit as Credit Spread (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +0.60%) ABOVE TREND indicates rising stress.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -8.41%) BELOW TREND is down sharply. Market internals RISK-ON: SPY (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +4.89%) ABOVE TREND and XLK (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND driving flows; CREDIT STRESS RISING: Credit Spread (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +0.60%) → flat/ABOVE TREND is a watch item.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: Dollar (Dollar Strength 1W: -0.26% | 1M: -1.72%) BELOW TREND is a touch weaker, Yield Curve (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -0.65%) BELOW TREND roughly flat, and TLT (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -0.94%) BELOW TREND—no aggressive move into duration.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech-led: XLK (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +19.31%) ABOVE TREND are the clear leaders; Financials showing strength in breadth (Financials sector 1W: +1.22% | 1M: +8.30%) supporting cyclicals. Defensives weak: XLP (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -3.32%) BELOW TREND and XLU (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -1.43%) BELOW TREND—Style: Growth/momentum leading.

**5. US vs Global?**
US leadership intact: SPY (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +4.89%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +4.96% | 1M: +6.29%) ABOVE TREND outpacing EM and DM. EM showing catch-up: EEM (1W: +3.60% | 1M: +6.30%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +2.59% | 1M: +0.92%) ABOVE TREND—global risk-on backdrop.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative demand healthy: ARKK (1W: +12.22% | 1M: +5.86%) ABOVE TREND, IBIT (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +1.09%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.05% | 1M: +7.96%) ABOVE TREND—speculation backing the rally.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation tilt: CPER (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +4.17% | 1M: -0.59%) RECOVERY showing industrial/metal strength, while GLD (1W: +0.50% | 1M: -4.18%) RECOVERY is softer versus equities.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.67%) BELOW TREND and UNG (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -11.64%) BELOW TREND—BNO (1W: +1.15% | 1M: -0.65%) in RECOVERY but not leadership.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech/semis (XLK, SOXX) and broad indices (SPY, QQQ, IWM) are ABOVE TREND and align with falling VXX—supports RISK-ON. DIVERGENCE: Credit Spread rising and defensives (XLP, XLU) BELOW TREND create a modest headwind; divergence severity MINOR (1W/1M mismatch concentrated in select sectors).

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor tech/momentum and cyclicals (XLK (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +19.31%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +3.05% | 1M: +7.96%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to defensives/energy (XLP (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -3.32%) BELOW TREND, XLE (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.67%) BELOW TREND). Monitor credit and volatility for reversal risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +7.00% | 1M: +9.08%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.22% | 1M: +19.31%) ABOVE TREND, XBI (1W: +2.76% | 1M: +9.07%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLE (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.67%) BELOW TREND, XLP (1W: -2.42% | 1M: -3.32%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +4.91%) ABOVE TREND, SLV (1W: +4.17% | 1M: -0.59%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -0.92% | 1M: -11.64%) BELOW TREND, broader energy complex XLE (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -2.67%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (current VIX proxy 1W: -3.59% | 1M: -8.41%) watch 30 for complacency shift; Credit Spread/HYG-LQD ~0.73 (1W: +0.28% | 1M: +0.60%) watch 0.80 for stress. Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT 1W: +3.52% | 1M: +6.78%) watch ~8.0 as pivot; XLK/XLF ratio current ~2.92 (1W: +4.01% | 1M: +3.31%) watch for leadership inflection.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, supported by falling VXX (1W: -3.59% | 1M: -8.41%) BELOW TREND and SPY (1W: +3.20% | 1M: +4.89%) ABOVE TREND. Tech/semis (XLK, SOXX) and small caps (IWM) showing strength; key risk is rising credit stress (Credit Spread 1W: +0.28% | 1M: +0.60%) and weak defensives (XLP, XLE) that could signal a sharper rotation if volatility reasserts.
